zh: 贝尔法斯特女王大学（Queen's University Belfast，简称QUB）成立于1845年，位于英国北爱尔兰首府贝尔法斯特，是一所世界一流的综合研究型大学、北爱尔兰地区最高学府、英国老牌名校、罗素大学集团成员、英联邦大学协会成员、欧洲大学协会成员。在2026年QS世界大学排名中位列全球第199位。学校拥有21个学科进入全球前200，其中四个学科进入全球前100，99%的研究环境被评为世界领先或国际优秀。
en: Queen's University Belfast (QUB), founded in 1845, is located in Belfast, the capital of Northern Ireland, UK. It is a world-class comprehensive research university, the highest institution of higher education in Northern Ireland, a prestigious UK university, a member of the Russell Group, the Association of Commonwealth Universities, and the European University Association. Ranked 199th in the QS World University Rankings 2026, the university has 21 subjects in the global top 200, with four subjects in the global top 100, and 99% of its research environment rated as world-leading or internationally excellent.
